user_saw: Cleanup, exact-session search, and ACP replay appends could take longer on large session stores.
summary: The fix skips SQLite work for protected transcripts, scopes exact-session searches to the selected session, removes an unused read, and counts replay events only when a session could exceed its cap.
reasoning: The PR reports CPU savings on synthetic workloads and matching results for cleanup, search, and replay. The replay query already counted every session before #139982 moved it to a prepared query, and #147166 introduced exact-session search with the existing unscoped dirty-state lookup. The evidence supports a performance improvement to existing behavior.
